criteria.reason: Attempts Rumantsch Grischun with RG vocabulary in the body, but closing formula and placeholders drift into Italian/French and syntax is garbled.
Date, time, purpose and hall-booking request are all present and clearly discernible.
Formal greeting, thanks in advance, offer of availability and formal closing maintain a courteous official register.

summary: Courteous formal booking letter in attempted Rumantsch Grischun with all key details, though contaminated by Italian/French phrasing and garbled syntax.
